bugs.error_message: M272 initial full CTest failed in whole-system mass audit with residual=0.057020 m3 after SWMM API-lateral bridge wiring.
bugs.root_cause: The concrete SWMM provider's raw external-net observation was passed to the audit without removing the API lateral component already represented by CouplingLib surface exchange.
bugs.fix: Added a deduplicated SWMM audit observation that removes the API lateral component exactly once.

bugs.error_message: M272 first bridge build failed because routingStep was not available in addExternalInflows(DateTime).
bugs.root_cause: The bridge initially attempted to accumulate API lateral volume at the inflow call site, although routing-total integration already supplies the interval.
bugs.fix: Kept API lateral as a step flow component integrated by massbal_updateRoutingTotals.

bugs.error_message: G26 declared ci_gate:false but CTest labeled test_swmm_external_net as golden.
bugs.root_cause: The manifest checker did not reject the golden label on non-gating entries.
bugs.fix: Changed G26 to candidate_non_gating and added the matching manifest invariant.

bugs.error_message: SimDriver baseline sampled raw SWMM external net while epoch samples subtracted API lateral using a second observation.
bugs.root_cause: API lateral deduplication was split across two hooks and only applied to current epoch samples.
bugs.fix: SwmmEngine now exposes one deduplicated audit observation used for baseline and epoch samples.

bugs.error_message: MSBUILD error MSB1009: test_goldensuite_manifest.vcxproj does not exist.
bugs.root_cause: test_goldensuite_manifest is a CTest registration, not a build target.
bugs.fix: Build executable targets and invoke the manifest check through ctest.

bugs.error_message: dflowfm_spike_host.exe: error while loading shared libraries: dflowfm.dll: cannot open shared object file
bugs.root_cause: Git Bash did not pass the prefixed POSIX PATH to the Windows loader.
bugs.fix: Run the spike through cmd.exe with the D-Flow release bin prepended to Windows PATH.

bugs.error_message: Standalone M273 spike build failed with LNK1181 because install_fm-suite_release/lib/dflowfm.lib does not exist.
bugs.root_cause: The release install provides the DLL while the import library is at the Delft3D source root.

bugs.error_message: M273 completion review agent could not run because the API reported insufficient credits (402).
bugs.root_cause: The subagent credit budget was exhausted.
bugs.fix: Completed spike-only scope and reproducibility checks inline.

bugs.error_message: gh pr update-branch 70 failed because M272 and M273 both added OpenWolf/index files.
bugs.root_cause: Parallel M272/M273 branches had add/add conflicts in generated context files and overlapping INDEX/memory additions.
bugs.fix: Merged latest master in a clean sync worktree and semantically combined M272 and M273 records.

bugs.error_message: Initial M274 ifx invocation mangled /c, /O2 and /I through MSYS path conversion and could not open m_flow.mod.
bugs.root_cause: Git Bash rewrote native Intel compiler switches as POSIX paths.
bugs.fix: Set MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*' and use /I:<path>; the bridge object then compiled successfully.

bugs.error_message: Clean external D-Flow configure stopped because Conan was not installed and the required delft3d_windows_msvc_194_v2 profile was absent.
bugs.root_cause: The local D-Flow source snapshot used the new Conan 2 build flow, but this machine only retained older build artifacts and no current Conan user configuration.
bugs.fix: Installed Conan 2.31.2 and ran run_conan.py initialize external to install governed profiles/settings without Deltares Nexus remotes.

bugs.error_message: G27 leg1 failed: sum(vol1)=6500 != native vol1tot=5500 at initialize on the open-boundary case; storage delta over 10 steps disagreed with boundary flux by 3.14 m3
bugs.root_cause: BMI vol1 array stores internal cells first, then boundary ghost nodes (ndxi..ndx). M258/M259 confirmed sum(vol1)==storage on a CLOSED case only; on open-boundary models the full sum overcounts physical storage by the ghost volumes, whose dynamics also pollute deltas.
bugs.fix: Added DFlowFMEngine::internal_cell_count() (BMI scalar ndxi, fail-closed) and observe_dflowfm_internal_volume (sums vol1[0:ndxi]); RunLoopHooks.dflowfm_storage_volume override binds native vol1tot in real mode; G27 locks the discovery with an explicit full>internal+100 assertion on the open case and full==internal on the closed case.
